purpose: Gross-to-net payroll calculation: FICA (Social Security 6.2% up to the 2025 $176,100 wage base, Medicare 1.45% uncapped, Additional Medicare Tax 0.9% on cumulative wages over $200,000 per IRC 3101(b)(2)), pretax deduction ordering (401(k)/HSA/Section 125 reduce both FICA and federal-taxable wages), and net pay. federal_withholding_per_period is a declared input, normally fed from art-338-compute-federal-withholding's output, since kernels cannot import one another. Federal only, not tax advice, state withholding and state payroll taxes out of scope. Consumes art-338-compute-federal-withholding. Not compute_federal_withholding itself, which only computes the federal income tax withholding line.
